review_scope: Read-only independent source review and separately authored tests; no build or mutation of implementation tree
findings_closed_in_reviewed_source: Raw operating_point decoder is an empty strict struct variant, so extra keys are rejected.
Transient-state charge history uses the same semiconductor seeding helper as operating-point initialization.
Intrinsic charge topology uses parsed internal junction terminals, preserving actual series resistances.
Diode, BJT transit/depletion, MOS bulk/overlap/channel and JFET charge paths participate in admission.
Mixed source/charge cycles fail explicitly before solve, instead of exposing basis-dependent source currents.
VCVS/CCVS outputs enter the combined topology only; the direct-clamp exception remains restricted to stationary independent voltage sources.
Temporary voltage constraints are removed before the first backward-Euler step; native capacitor/inductor values remain unchanged.
verification_limit: All native graph audits are source-derived. Production parser admission, all new test results, nonlinear convergence and actual native execution remain separate required gates. No runtime readiness is claimed by this review.
